finding: Harness is now a direct validation/falsification/repair method for Frank v0.1 rather than a separate product. The effect lifecycle component passed 40/40 local tests including policy mutation, concurrent confirmation, crash/restart and trace-tamper checks; ingress-trust/precommit gates were added for untrusted control paths.

Local reference execution is not target-VPS provider/fault evidence.
counterhypotheses: Field-level taint plus precommit gating may be unnecessarily complex if a smaller provenance boundary is equally fail-closed.
Durable lifecycle may be reducible for fully idempotent provider classes.
required_validation: Target Hostinger fault injection and provider-specific reconciliation/idempotency.
Direct Frank v0.1 end-to-end effect/outcome/reentry traces.
ancestry_policy: Effect-lifecycle follow-up commits sharing the same worker/run ancestry are one evidence lineage, not independent replication.
